title: SPAWN_TICK frequencies are an octave above their documented 'fifth above the body' / D5-E5-C5 labels
evidence:
+SPAWN_BODY   :: [3]f32{392, 440, 349}  // mid body (an octave up)
+SPAWN_TICK   :: [3]f32{1175, 1320, 1046} // high tick (a fifth above the body)
+| `assets/audio/spawn_01.ogg` | node-spawn chime, variant 1 | G3 thump + G4 body + D5 tick |
detail: 1175 Hz over the 392 Hz body is an octave plus a fifth (D6), not 'a fifth above the body' (D5≈587); README labels D5/E5/C5 contradict the shipped constants by one octave.
recommended_fix: Either halve SPAWN_TICK to {587, 659, 523} to match the documented intent, or correct the code comment and README to D6/E6/C6.

title: Live fast-path PIPE_DRAWN emission (commit_draw's sim_events append) has no test coverage in the diff
detail: No diff test drives commit_draw's sim_events append; parity nils it deliberately and the goldens pin only step's replay emission. A wrong tick or deleted append passes CI.
recommended_fix: Add an exec-level test asserting the fast-path event lands at inp.tick+1 in sim_events, with a revert-style control like the earlier pause/effect pins.

title: kind_volume's trailing return is unreachable and silently masks future non-exhaustive switches
detail: Unreachable while the switch is exhaustive; a future fifth Sound_Kind member would silently fall back to ARRIVAL_VOLUME instead of failing the build.
recommended_fix: Remove the trailing return so a new Sound_Kind member breaks compilation (exhaustive-switch safety).
